zones.title: HMIP survey zones, FeatureServer/2 (current geography year 2026)

source.assignmentMethod: Each neighbourhood is assigned to the CMHC survey zone holding the largest share of its area (turf intersect, WGS84). PROVISIONAL: zone polygons are the 2026 geography layer, while the 2025 rent tables use 2021 census zone definitions; no official 2025 polygon layer was available. Rent benchmarks are zone means, never neighbourhood prices.
